description: An fpdart-style developer-experience wrapper over hive_ce: gives Hive's Box/LazyBox a typed functional surface (Task/TaskOption/Option, no nulls), ready-made CRUD, and purpose-built box variants (single-value, collection, dual-index, reverse-query).
rules: hive_box_manager wraps hive_ce's Box/LazyBox behind typed Manager classes with an fpdart surface: reads return Task/TaskOption/Option and writes return Task<Unit>; there is no bare Future or null on the public API, and genuine absence is an Option.
The package is pure Dart (usable in Flutter, server, and CLI). hive_ce is the storage engine and fpdart is the paradigm; Flutter-specific adapters belong in companion packages, not core.

The package is being rewritten from scratch for a breaking 1.0. Concrete API rules (the Manager method set, the eager-vs-lazy split, the box variants and their key handling) will be finalised as the redo lands.
